meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress natural language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format to save input tokens. Preserves all technical substance, code, URLs, and structure. Compressed version overwrites the original file. Human-readable backup saved as FILE.original.md. Trigger: /caveman-compress FILEPATH or "compress memory file"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把记忆文件压成精简格式,节省输入开销
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果用 AI 工具时觉得上下文太占空间、又想保留关键信息
copy.tagline_en: Compress memory files into a terse format to cut input costs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI tools and want smaller context without losing key details

howto.what: 把自然语言记忆文件(如 CLAUDE.md、待办事项、偏好)压缩成 caveman 简短格式,以节省输入 token;保留代码、URL 和结构,压缩版覆盖原文件,并把原文件备份到备份目录。
howto.when: 当你说出“/caveman-compress 文件路径”命令,或要求“压缩记忆文件”时触发。

say.note: 压缩该文件,原文件会备份到备份目录。
触发压缩流程,需提供文件路径。

say.text: 把 todos.md 压缩成 caveman 格式
say.note: 只压缩文本,代码和链接原样保留。

howto.what_en: Compress natural-language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format to save input tokens. Preserves technical substance, code, URLs, and structure. Compressed version overwrites original; human-readable backup saved separately.
howto.when_en: Triggered by the command '/caveman-compress <filepath>' or when the user asks to compress a memory file (e.g., 'compress memory file').

say_en.note: Compresses the file; original backed up.
Starts compression; you'll need to specify a file.
Only prose is compressed; code and links stay intact.
